cohort: The study included all neonates admitted into the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at the National Hospital Abuja (NHA) over a 13-month period from January 2017 to February 2018.
finding: Congenital malformations had the highest case-specific fatality rate (32.5%), followed by perinatal asphyxia (28.6%) and prematurity (20.7%), with differing mortality patterns observed between inborn and outborn babies.
followup_time: Up to 28 days postpartum (the neonatal period) or until hospital discharge/death during this period
